name: PT Pembangunan Perumahan Properti Tbk
summary: PT Pembangunan Perumahan Properti Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, engages in real estate business in Indonesia. It operates through Realty and Property segments. The company is involved in the sale of land and/or building and apartment units under strata-title; development and management of hotel guestrooms, retail center, mall and edutainment, and restaurants. The company was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia. PT Pembangunan Perumahan Properti Tbk operates as a subsidiary of PT Pembangunan Perumahan (Persero) Tbk.
